description: This PHP source file defines the class 'Chart_lead_source_by_outcome', which generates a chart visualization for lead sources by outcome within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for drawing the chart, generating XML data for the chart, and constructing SQL queries to retrieve relevant opportunity data, with embedded HTML for configuration UI.

classes.name: Chart_lead_source_by_outcome
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering a lead source analysis chart by outcome within the SuiteCRM module, including data retrieval, XML generation for chart rendering, and user interface components.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Displays the chart, handles user preferences, and embeds HTML for chart configuration.

methods.name: gen_xml
methods.description: Generates XML data for the chart by querying opportunities, aggregating data grouped by lead source and sales stage, and caching the output.

methods.name: constructQuery
methods.description: Builds and returns the SQL query string used to fetch opportunity data relevant to the chart.

methods.name: constructGroupBy
methods.description: Returns the grouping criteria for SQL queries, specifically lead source and sales stage.
